# Teltonika RMS Provider

Manage Teltonika RMS companies, devices, users, roles, tasks and VPN hubs. Configure the provider with an API token, either inline or via the TELTONIKA_RMS_TOKEN environment variable.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    rms = {
      source = "moep90/rms"
    }
  }
}

provider "rms" {
  # May also be set via the TELTONIKA_RMS_TOKEN environment variable.
  token = var.rms_token
}

variable "rms_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `base_url` (String) Base URL for the Teltonika RMS API. Defaults to https://rms.teltonika-networks.com/api
- `max_retry` (Number) Maximum number of retries for failed requests. Defaults to 3.
- `timeout` (Number) Request timeout in seconds. Defaults to 30.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) API token for authentication. Can also be set via TELTONIKA_RMS_TOKEN environment variable.
